profile.headline: Software Engineer | Java, Spring Boot, React, Kubernetes | Fintech & Distributed Systems | TN Visa Holder (No Sponsorship Required)
profile.summary: Passionate about software architecture and distributed systems and their applications in global problems. As a professional I bring both interests to the world of technology. I am a practitioner and advocate of QA, and have helped design and implement products to solve end-user problems.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Built and shipped reusable React UI modules that orchestrated internal banking components, enabling flexible client-specific integrations and
reducing on-boarding time across 19 product teams.
• Integrated Stripe as a unified payment processor by developing customer and non-customer on-boarding flows for cards and bank accounts,
improving payment reliability by reducing payment rate failure to 0.01% and reducing dependency on legacy payment vendors and lowering
operational costs.
• Designed and documented Stripe’s end-to-end architecture, defining component interactions and security considerations to ensure scalability
across 20 bank products.
• Partnered with backend, frontend, and Stripe engineering teams to align architecture, conduct technical reviews, and drive successful integra-
tion of Stripe within distributed banking systems.
Technologies: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Spring Boot, Stripe API, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Microservices, Docker, Kafka
positions.insights: Arquitectura de software, Tech lead and +2 skills

positions.title: Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented 12+ scalable microservices using Java and Spring Boot, supporting enterprise banking platforms and improving
system scalability and reliability.
• Improved system reliability and reduced production debugging time by implementing observability solutions using Grafana, Kibana, Jaeger,
and ELK Stack.
• Enhanced platform security by implementing authentication and role-based access controls, ensuring secure access to enterprise systems.
• Automated application deployment pipelines using Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and GitLab CI/CD, improving deployment reliability and reduc-
ing manual operational overhead.
• Decomposed monolithic systems into scalable microservices architectures, improving system scalability, maintainability, and performance.
• Improved system availability and reliability by defining Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and implementing monitoring and alerting systems.
• Contributed to distributed system architecture decisions, improving scalability and long-term platform maintainability.
Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, GitLab CI/CD, Grafana, ELK Stack, Kafka

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented scalable REST APIs enabling secure integration between enterprise insurance systems.
• Developed secure authentication and authorization systems using Spring Security to protect sensitive customer data.
• Collaborated with frontend teams to integrate backend services into production applications, improving system functionality and user experi-
ence.
Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Spring Security, Angular.

positions.title: Junior Software Architect
positions.locationName: Orizaba, Veracruz de Ignacio de la Llave, México
positions.description:
• Designed and prototyped a scalable medical platform using Spring Boot and Angular, improving modularity and enabling faster feature devel-
opment.
• Defined API contracts and system architecture to support scalable backend services.
• Contributed to backend system implementation and architectural improvements.
Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, Angular
positions.insights: Software Development, Public Speaking and +5 skills

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description:
• Developed backend REST APIs supporting core business functionality.
• Translated business requirements into scalable backend services.
• Collaborated with senior engineers to design scalable backend systems.
Technologies: Java, Spring Framework, REST APIs.
positions.insights: Software Development, Business Analyst and +4 skills
